title: A readable type scale, Alegreya for the game's words and fewer capitals
notes: Type scale re-spaced around a 16px body (the board's base 14px); no step under 11px outside cards/; card names and rules text, headings, titles and banners in Alegreya; capitals kept only for one shared small-caps label rule and the card faces' printed inscriptions. How cards look only: no card plays differently.

player.title: Larger, easier type
changes: Card names and rules text are now set in the game's serif, Alegreya.
Text across the menus and the board is larger, and far fewer labels are in capitals.
